## HOW TO CHECK

```
node daemon/health.mjs --gaps
node daemon/health.mjs
node bench/ladder.mjs
node tools/schedule-autopilot.mjs --status
node tools/schedule-ladder.mjs --status
node bin/brain.mjs self-code --auto --dry --json
```

`node daemon/health.mjs --gaps` prints the gap counters in one line with no server; with no flag it serves GET /health on 127.0.0.1:8080 (HEALTH_PORT overrides). `node bench/ladder.mjs` with no flag prints the board from the verdicts on disk. The dry self-code run lists every candidate the loop would try, writes nothing and asks no model.

## HOW TO STOP AND RESTART

- the switch: `state/self/STOP`; present now: no, the loop runs at its next tick. While it exists the tick refuses to start (exit 0, one line in the day's log) and a running soak ends between rounds.
- the pid lock: `state/self-code/autopilot.lock` (one autopilot per tree); present now: yes, pid 40856 since 2026-09-25T21:42:55.724Z. A lock whose process is gone is taken over by the next run and the takeover is printed, so a crash never needs a hand to clear it.

Stop the loop, then start it again:

```
node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('state/self/STOP', 'stopped by hand')"
node -e "require('fs').rmSync('state/self/STOP', {force: true})"
```

Take the tasks off the machine, or put them back (the same lines as above), or run the autopilot task once now:

```
node tools/schedule-autopilot.mjs --remove
node tools/schedule-autopilot.mjs --register
node tools/schedule-autopilot.mjs --run-now
node tools/schedule-ladder.mjs --remove
node tools/schedule-ladder.mjs --register
schtasks /delete /tn BrainAutopilot /f
schtasks /delete /tn BrainLadder /f
schtasks /run /tn BrainAutopilot
```

A soak that was killed continues from its checkpoint (state/self/soak-<runId>.json) with:

```
node bin/brain.mjs self-code --auto --resume
```

## HOW TO DEPLOY THE SITE

```
node web/build.mjs
node tools/deploy.mjs web/dist
```

`node web/build.mjs` writes web/dist (the organism page, findings, portfolio, ladder and this file at /handoff). `node tools/deploy.mjs web/dist` runs the Vercel CLI through npx (`npx vercel@latest`), links the project "dilation" and deploys to production, aliased to dilation.dev; it prints every command before it runs it. The CLI login made once on this machine by device login lives in the CLI's own data folder under %APPDATA% (com.vercel.cli); present now: yes. This file never reads it and carries no credential. If the deploy prints that the CLI is not logged in, he runs the login himself:

```
npx vercel@latest login
```

## HOW TO PUSH THE REPOSITORY

- git repository at this tree: yes, branch master
- remotes: `origin	https://github.com/j4ydenlxl/brain.git (fetch)`, `origin	https://github.com/j4ydenlxl/brain.git (push)`

Pushing is his to do: the GitHub login and the remote are his, and no credential is written anywhere in this tree. With the GitHub CLI (it opens a browser for his login), or with a remote URL he already has:

```
git remote -v
gh auth login
gh repo create <name> --private --source . --remote origin --push
git remote add origin <url>
git push -u origin master
```
